author: claude-opus-5-5
visual_review: Before was an eight-bump blob with pinched spiky valleys and no swirl, so it read as a splat or cog. Now there are seven round petals (r6 circles tangent to each other on a ring), and each petal continues past its valley as an inward hook, giving the reference's pinwheel swirl.
omissions: Hooks are shorter than the reference's (40 degrees of arc) to keep 8-unit spacing between neighbours.
